Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 1, Verse 14

“Then, seated in a great chariot yoked with white horses, Krishna and Arjuna blew their divine conches.”

The scene shifts to the other side. Krishna and Arjuna, sharing one magnificent chariot, answer the Kaurava fanfare — the divine paired with the human, a partnership at the heart of the entire Gita.
